strings.zh: 如果你有NDS或者3DS,{NEWLINE}就可以用精灵中心的设备跟朋友联机。{SCROLL}比如使用圆形剧场可以通信对战。{NEWLINE}通信对战的次数和对战战绩{CLEAR}会记录在训练师卡片的背面哦。
strings.en: If you have a DS or 3DS, you can{NEWLINE}link up with friends using the{CLEAR}machines in the Pokémon Center.{SCROLL}For example, you can have link battles{NEWLINE}in the Colosseum. Your number of link{CLEAR}battles and your record are saved{CLEAR}on the back of your Trainer Card.

strings.notes: US 0583/1 Disguised-player line (vanilla Rocket uniform); US reworded to match zh 什么啊,火箭队吗.

strings.zh: 这世界上存在着{NEWLINE}多少种精灵呢？{SCROLL}很久以前,大木博士{NEWLINE}曾经发表过「有１５０种！」{NEWLINE}这样的宣言……{SCROLL}从那以后全国各地,{NEWLINE}新种类的精灵{CLEAR}陆陆续续被发现,{SCROLL}现在已经确认{NEWLINE}有将近５００种{CLEAR}精灵存在了呀……
strings.en: I wonder how many kinds of Pokémon{NEWLINE}there are in the world.{SCROLL}A long time ago, Professor Oak said{NEWLINE}there were 150 different kinds...{SCROLL}Since then, many new Pokémon have{NEWLINE}been discovered in different regions.{SCROLL}There are almost 500 different kinds{NEWLINE}known now...

strings.notes: US 0583/3 | RV035: omission: 啊 interjection kept; no added '!'

strings.zh: 不管级别有多高,{NEWLINE}因为有属性相克,{SCROLL}绝对强的精灵总是{NEWLINE}不存在的哦。
strings.en: No matter how high a Pokémon’s level is,{NEWLINE}type matchups mean there’s never{CLEAR}one Pokémon that’s absolutely{CLEAR}the strongest.
strings.notes: US 0583/4 | RV035: meaning: Chinese states it flatly (绝对强的精灵总是不存在); US 'I don’t think' hedge removed

strings.zh: 好像在哪里见过你……{SCROLL}似乎有见过那样打扮{NEWLINE}的人……？
strings.en: Have I seen you somewhere before...?{SCROLL}I feel like I’ve seen someone{NEWLINE}dressed like that...?
strings.notes: US 0583/5 US line (asks why they look like that) replaced: zh says ‘I think I’ve seen someone dressed like that’.

strings.zh: 我不反对你{NEWLINE}身为火箭图一员,{CLEAR}帮忙回复精灵的体力。{SCROLL}但我劝你别到{NEWLINE}其他地方晃悠。
strings.en: Hey, I don’t mind restoring a Pokémon’s{NEWLINE}health, even when they belong to{CLEAR}Team Rocket...{SCROLL}But stay away from other places, OK?

strings.zh: 我去口袋妖怪占卜之家占卜,{NEWLINE}那里的老奶奶说含羞苞是{CLEAR}最合适我的精灵。{SCROLL}可是在城都地区含羞苞是很少见的,{NEWLINE}我根本不知道要去哪里抓。{CLEAR}如果大哥哥有含羞苞的话,{CLEAR}能跟我的百变怪交换吗？
strings.en: I had my fortune told at the{NEWLINE}Pokémon Fortune House, and the{CLEAR}old lady there said Budew is the{CLEAR}Pokémon that suits me best.{SCROLL}But Budew are really rare in Johto,{NEWLINE}and I have no idea where to catch{CLEAR}one. Mister, if you have a Budew,{CLEAR}would you trade it for my Ditto?
strings.notes: Male-player variant (大哥哥 → ‘mister’); #13/#14 female (大姐姐 → ‘miss’).

strings.zh: 连大哥哥也没有含羞苞吗？{NEWLINE}果然含羞苞是很少见的精灵啊。
strings.en: You don’t have a Budew either, mister?{NEWLINE}I guess Budew really are rare.

strings.zh: 这样一来我也有含羞苞咯！{NEWLINE}也就是说我可以获得幸福了吧。
strings.en: Now I’ve got a Budew too! That{NEWLINE}means I’ll find happiness, right?

strings.zh: 我想要含羞苞,其他精灵不行的。
strings.en: I want a Budew. No{NEWLINE}other Pokémon will do.

strings.zh: 我会好好培养含羞苞的,{NEWLINE}但是希望它不要进化,{CLEAR}不然就不是含羞苞了。
strings.en: I’ll take good care raising my Budew.{NEWLINE}But I hope it never evolves, or it won’t{CLEAR}be a Budew anymore.
strings.notes: | RV035: addition: 'with lots of love' not in 好好培养

strings.zh: 火箭队不会来抢我的精灵吧？
strings.en: Team Rocket won’t come and{NEWLINE}steal my Pokémon, will they?

strings.zh: 我去口袋妖怪占卜之家占卜,{NEWLINE}那里的老奶奶说含羞苞是{CLEAR}最合适我的精灵。{SCROLL}可是在城都地区含羞苞是很少见的,{NEWLINE}我根本不知道要去哪里抓。{CLEAR}如果大姐姐有含羞苞的话,{CLEAR}能跟我的百变怪交换吗？
strings.en: I had my fortune told at the{NEWLINE}Pokémon Fortune House, and the{CLEAR}old lady there said Budew is the{CLEAR}Pokémon that suits me best.{SCROLL}But Budew are really rare in Johto,{NEWLINE}and I have no idea where to catch{CLEAR}one. Miss, if you have a Budew,{CLEAR}would you trade it for my Ditto?

strings.zh: 连大姐姐也没有含羞苞吗？{NEWLINE}果然含羞苞是很少见的精灵啊。
strings.en: You don’t have a Budew either, miss?{NEWLINE}I guess Budew really are rare.

strings.zh: 赫拉克罗斯是虫加格斗属性的精灵,{NEWLINE}有了它我一定能打赢{CLEAR}满金道馆的挑战赛。
strings.en: Heracross is a Bug- and Fighting-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon. With it, I’m sure I can{CLEAR}win the Goldenrod Gym challenge.

strings.zh: 耶,我拿到满金道馆的正式徽章了！
strings.en: Yes! I got the Plain Badge{NEWLINE}from the Goldenrod Gym!

strings.zh: 赫拉克罗斯,{NEWLINE}如果火箭队敢进精灵中心,{CLEAR}咱们就去揍他们！
strings.en: Heracross, if Team Rocket dares{NEWLINE}to set foot in the Pokémon Center,{CLEAR}we’ll go beat them up!
